text:
Noah: quick follow-up on the ingest fairness RFC — we need concrete lease/WFQ defaults and a short ops playbook after yesterday's noisy-client incident.
Priya: tl;dr of incident?
Noah: mobile SDK rollout caused a spike of retries, one shard hit full queue and blocked other tenants for ~2m.
Zoe: we should shard WFQ and hand out short token leases (100ms) to smooth refills. also a low-priority hint so we can compact/drop less important telemetry.
Santiago: implementation: per-shard WFQ with limited queue_slots and per-tenant token buckets. lease_ttl_ms=100, queue_slots=1024.
Priya: defaults proposal: tenant_rate=50qps, burst=100, shard_wfq=true, low_priority_compaction=true.
Noah: compaction rules (low-priority): metrics -> rollup 1s, logs -> sample/drop body, spans -> keep root+errors only. documentable per-tenant opt-in.
Zoe: metrics surface: tenant.tokens_used_total, tenant.tokens_denied_total, shard.queue_depth, ingest.compacted_count, ingest.shard_congested_pct. tracing tags for drops: ingest.drop_reason.
Santiago: ops runbook: on shard_congested > 5% for 5m -> query top tenants by tokens_used -> apply temporary throttle via admin API -> notify tenant owner.
Noah: Dedicated customers: separate reserved pool that bypasses soft tenant budget but still obeys global safety.
Priya: rollout: feature gate in staging -> canary 5% shards -> 25% -> global. monitor shard.queue_depth, global_rejects, p95 latency.
ingest-bot: CONFIG: wfq.enabled=true, lease_ttl_ms=100 applied to staging.
Noah: I'll open PR with defaults, metrics, compaction rules, and the runbook. please review.
Priya: nit: use _total suffix for counters.
Zoe: add dashboard: per-shard heatmap + top tenants.
Noah: noted, thanks. :thumbsup:
